name: KummerCriterion.BernoulliFast.binomSum_eq
statement:
theorem binomSum_eq (bs : List ℚ) (m : ℕ) :
    binomSum bs m =

name: KummerCriterion.BernoulliFast.binomSum_loop_cons
statement:
theorem binomSum_loop_cons (m k : ℕ) (b : ℚ) (rest : List ℚ) (c acc : ℚ) :
    binomSum.loop m (b :: rest) k c acc =
      binomSum.loop m rest (k + 1)
        (c * ((m : ℚ) - k) / ((k : ℚ) + 1))
        (acc + c * b)

name: KummerCriterion.BernoulliFast.binomSum_loop_eq
statement:
theorem binomSum_loop_eq (m : ℕ) (bs : List ℚ) (k : ℕ) (c acc : ℚ)
    (hc : c = ↑(m.choose k)) :
    binomSum.loop m bs k c acc =
      acc + ∑ j ∈ range bs.length, ↑(m.choose (k + j)) * bs.getD j 0

name: KummerCriterion.CyclotomicUnits.deletedConvolution_mul_deletedCharacter
statement:
theorem deletedConvolution_mul_deletedCharacter

    deletedConvolutionMatrix (G := G) ρ q *
        deletedCharacterMatrix (G := G) ρ =
      deletedCharacterMatrix (G := G) ρ *

          deletedFourierCoeff (G := G) q χ.val)

name: KummerCriterion.CyclotomicUnits.sum_nonidentity_deletedConvolution_mulChar
statement:
theorem sum_nonidentity_deletedConvolution_mulChar
    [DecidableEq G]

    ∑ k : Nonidentity G, (q (h * k.val⁻¹) - q h) * χ k.val =
